personality: Fusion of 6 Glass / Luxe DARK and 7 Dark-First Utility
personality_one_liner: A sleek, high-trust digital command center that makes device optimization feel precise, deeply analytical, and reassuring.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing on the dashboard to emphasize the main progress ring; tighter spacing in lists (Scan/Insights) for high information density.

do's: Use glass on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers.
Apply glass to the main Device Health card over the circuit background.
Use glass for confirmation bottom sheets and action modals.
dont's: Do not use glass on dense list items or simple form inputs.
Do not stack more than 2 glass surfaces on one screen.

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: Brand introduction with an animated V logo using Skia circuit lines.

states.loading: Animated drawing of the V logo paths.

screens.layout: Full-bleed gradient from deep navy-teal to dark teal, with the stylized V logo centered. Subtle background circuit pattern overlaid with low opacity.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Educate the user on device health, security, and cleaning benefits in 3-4 slides.
screens.layout: Full-screen scenes with large animated illustrations/SVGs on top. Title, subtitle, and a sticky 'Next' primary button wrapped in a glass container at the bottom.

screens.name: Pro Paywall
screens.purpose: Upsell screen with feature comparison and subscription tiers.

states.error: Error message with 'Retry' to fetch subscription data.

screens.layout: Cinematic dark layout. Featured graphic at the top, followed by a highlighted glassmorphic card comparing Free vs Pro. Monthly/Yearly toggle pills, and a large primary 'Unlock Pro' button sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Home (Dashboard)
screens.purpose: Centralized at-a-glance device health metrics and primary entry point for Smart Scan.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for the metric cards.
states.error: Error fetching device stats with a 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Large hero section featuring an animated circular progress ring (Health Score) using Skia. Below, a 2-column grid of quick stats (Storage, RAM, Battery, Security) using tonal cards. A sticky 'Smart Scan' FAB or bottom-anchored CTA button.

screens.name: Scan Hub
screens.purpose: Grid/list of bite-sized optimization tools like Duplicate Photos, Large Files, etc.
screens.layout: Categorized sections (e.g., Storage, Performance). Use horizontal scrolling cards for suggested cleanups, and a vertical list for all other tools with clear icons and brief descriptions.

screens.name: Results / Confirmation
screens.purpose: Before/after cleanup report and celebratory reinforcement.

states.error: Failed to clean, with a retry option.

screens.layout: A 'Congratulations' layout showing space saved or threats removed via a large success graphic. Detailed breakdown below. Prominent 'Done' button.

screens.name: Insights
screens.purpose: Detailed analytics for Storage, Battery, and Security.
screens.layout: Segmented controls at the top (Storage, Battery, Security). Content switches below. Storage shows a donut chart breakdown. Battery shows health %, cycle count, and temperature. Security shows a threat status card and list.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage profile, subscription, and app preferences.
screens.layout: Standard vertical list with grouped sections. Prominent 'Manage Pro' banner at the top if subscribed, or 'Upgrade to Pro' if not.

splash_bg.alt: Intricate green circuit board featuring glowing lines and components

pro_hero_bg.alt: Green concentric circles with vertical lines on black background

security_card_bg.alt: Green glowing particles forming a horizontal pattern on dark background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: Deep navy-teal bases (surface: #050F14, surfaceSecondary: #0B1B24) with fresh green accents (brandPrimary: #10B981). Do NOT use any generic blues or purples.
The Home dashboard MUST feature a large, beautifully animated circular progress ring (health score) using React Native Skia. The ring should have a gradient stroke moving from teal to fresh green.
Implement the 'V' logo for Verolane using Skia/SVG on the splash screen with subtle circuit-line details.
Use glassmorphism (expo-glass-effect/expo-blur) for the sticky bottom tab bar, bottom sheets, and the main hero card on the Home dashboard overlaying the circuit background image.
Ensure the UI feels 'at-a-glance'. For the Scan Hub, break complex tasks into bite-sized actionable sections (Photos, Large Files) instead of a single ambiguous 'Clean All' button.
For all cleanup actions, implement a confirmation modal (bottom sheet) with reassuring explanations before proceeding.
Add celebratory animations (e.g., Lottie or Skia particles) and 'Space Saved' metrics on the Results screen.
Include subtle haptics (impactLight/impactMedium) on primary interactions like starting a scan, toggling options, or completing a cleanup task.
Apply a top-to-bottom vertical gradient scrim when placing text over any background images (like the Pro Paywall hero).
